title: Catering for the way you gather

hero.alt: Four friends with Layers bowls around a table inside the shop

intro:
Layers offers a thoughtful catering experience, from the first conversation to the final delivery. Team breakfasts, wellness events, corporate meetings, private celebrations — we make nourishing your guests simple.

Performance smoothies, house-made bowls, sourdough toasts, specialty coffee, matcha, and wellness offerings, crafted with real ingredients and prepared with intention.
